title: Barber's team saw the same octagonal 'eight-gon' craft that Herrera described

tellings.quote: Well, interestingly enough, this particular craft, the eight at eight gone, is exactly what Michael Herrera reports to have seen.

plain: Jake Barber, who says he helped recover a UFO by helicopter, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that his team saw an eight-sided craft, which he calls an "eight-gon." He says it is exactly what Michael Herrera, another man who tells of seeing a strange craft, reports having seen, which would mean two separate accounts describe the same object.
